N15.scenario: N15 startup, first frame, idle CPU, host+backend memory, repeated window cycles, package size (KDE Wayland, installed release build)
commands: cd ~ && python3 tools/measure_resources.py --host ~/.cargo/bin/ui4me-host --cycles 400 --sample-every 100 --output verification/native-linux/evidence/linux-n15-measurements.json

observations.investigation: (1) host private memory grew 12.7 KiB per window create/close: AT-SPI D-Bus objects were never unregistered (accesskit_atspi_common), fixed by vendored patch -> 3.8 KiB/cycle; residual is zbus keeping the empty /org/a11y/atspi/accessible/<adapter> path node (no public API to prune). (2) idle host CPU 0.74% -> 0.23%: event loop now polls at 500 ms when no deadline is pending (was 50 ms) and the Linux IPC accept waits in poll() instead of 20 ms sleeps; also removed up to 20 ms connection latency (first frame 53->38 ms after host start). (3) CPU measured with per-thread schedstat runtime because tick-sampled utime/stime overstated short frequent wakes.
observations.memory_metric: PSS divides shared pages between processes; combined PSS (30.1 MB) is the meaningful host+backend total, summed RSS (40.6 MB) double counts shared libraries
